findings.F1: Above the 200-day average, the 10-day return minus the coin's mean rises with the close's place in its 20-day close range: +0.0335 in the top fifth of the range (t 2.56, 268 non-overlapping cases) against -0.0312 in the bottom fifth (t -2.86, 123 cases).
findings.F2: Below the 200-day average the same range position shows no gradient: the five bins run from -0.023 to +0.001, every |t| ≤ 1.3, so the range effect appears only in the uptrend regime.
findings.F3: Above the 200-day average, the next 10 days rise with the past 30-day return rather than fading after it: the lowest two quintiles give -0.028 (t -1.27, n 43) and -0.029 (t -2.53, n 88), and the highest two give +0.018 (t 1.54, n 168) and +0.022 (t 1.53, n 222). This is the opposite of the plan's extension penalty.
findings.F4: The recorded forecast itself barely sorts the next 10 days on trending bars: its top quintile gives +0.014 (t 0.97) and its bottom quintile +0.004 (t 0.45). The 60-bar standardisation and the cubic penalty appear to have blurred the plain range and momentum effects in F1 and F3.
findings.F5: The book loses most when it is positioned against strong moves: on its worst 2% of days (348) it lost 10.5% on average while the coin rose 7.9%, and on its best 2% it gained 9.4% while the coin fell 4.8%.
findings.F6: Long-held trades do the damage: the 109 trades held over 30 days lost 30.0% each on average, -3272 summed, against -663 for the 1270 trades held 3–10 days.
findings.F7: The weekday pattern is not strong enough to count, given how many angles were checked and that coins share the same days: Friday's next-day excess return is +0.0030 (t 3.76, n 2479) and Wednesday's is -0.0030 (t -2.70), with mixed signs across the rest of the week.

ideas.idea: While a coin's close is above its 200-day average, the higher its close sits in its 20-day close range, the larger its rise over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would size a long in an uptrending coin by how close it sits to its 20-day high, without a cut for extension, and would avoid such longs when the close sits near its 20-day low.
ideas.name: Uptrend range-position drift

ideas.idea: While a coin's close is above its 200-day average, the larger its 30-day return, the larger its rise over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would add to a long as the coin's 30-day run grows inside an uptrend, rather than cutting it back as the tested idea proposed.
ideas.name: Uptrend thirty-day momentum continuation
